name: mint-mac-care
title: Mint
description: See what fills your Mac, get space back without deleting anything, clean, organize folders, free memory and uninstall apps through Mint
author: dzg-studio

commands.name: mint-status
commands.title: View Mac Status
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Disk, memory and your organized folders on one screen, like Mint's menu bar

commands.name: mint-optimize
commands.title: Optimize Storage
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Identical copies share their storage. Nothing is deleted and every file stays where it is

commands.name: mint-scan
commands.title: Free Disk
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Mint's groups with what is in each: optimize copies, clean what apps make again, choose from your own files

commands.name: mint-organize
commands.title: Organize a Folder
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: How many files each folder has to sort and where they go, then organize it in one step

commands.name: mint-memory
commands.title: Free Memory
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Quit every idle app in one step, or choose the apps to quit

commands.name: mint-uninstall
commands.title: Uninstall App
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Find an app and what it left behind, then move them to the Trash

commands.name: mint-undo
commands.title: Undo Mint Action
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Put back files from a recent cleanup, uninstall or organize run

commands.name: mint-why
commands.title: Show Disk Growth
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: What grew on your disk this week, by app, folder, category or AI tool

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Publish this extension through the Raycast Store, not npm.' && exit 1
